faq.q: Is Aafiya the same name as Aafia?
faq.a: Yes - Aafiya and Aafia are two English spellings of the same Arabic name عافية, meaning 'health, well-being'.

faq.q: What does the name Aafiya mean?
faq.a: Aafiya means “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness”.

faq.q: Where does the name Aafiya come from?
What is the linguistic root of Aafiya?
faq.a: The root of Aafiya is ع-ف-و (ʿ-f-w).

faq.q: How is Aafiya written in Arabic script?
faq.a: Aafiya is written عافية in Arabic script.

faq.q: Is Aafiya a boy's or a girl's name?
faq.a: Aafiya is used as a female name.

faq.q: Does Aafiya appear in the Qur'an?
faq.a: No. Aafiya is not a Qur'anic name; it is used in Muslim naming tradition.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Aafiya verified?
faq.a: Yes — the meaning “Health; well-being; soundness; freedom from illness” is established by Arabic noun ʿāfiya 'health, well-being'; spelling variant of Aafia..
